source.label: Marvel.com Marvel Universe wiki: Thor (Thor Odinson) (archived 25 June 2018)

powerOrigins.detail: Son of Odin and the Elder Goddess Gaea, so stronger and tougher than almost every other Asgardian.
Mjolnir, an Uru hammer carrying Odin's enchantments, channels his storms, blasts, flight and portals; the Odin-Force has amplified him further.

abilities.name: Godly strength
abilities.detail: The strongest of the Asgardian gods, rated well above 100 tons, who has battled the Hulk, Hercules and the Midgard Serpent.

abilities.name: Near invulnerability
abilities.detail: Has withstood attacks from the Destroyer, blasts from Odin and even energy blasts from Celestials.

abilities.name: Weather control
abilities.detail: As God of Thunder he summons rain, wind, thunder and lightning, with or without Mjolnir.

abilities.name: Mjolnir
abilities.detail: His enchanted hammer returns to his hand, lets him fly, fires the God-Blast and opens portals across dimensions.

abilities.name: Speed and reflexes
abilities.detail: Flies at tremendous speeds and can track objects moving faster than light.

abilities.name: Odin-Force
abilities.detail: At times he has inherited his father's power, greatly boosting his strength and adding teleportation and force fields.

abilities.name: Master warrior
abilities.detail: Millennia of war make him a master combatant and an expert with hammer, axe, sword, bow and shield.

feats.text: Fought his way inside the Celestial Exitar and broke into its brain casing, shattering Mjolnir with the force he channelled.
When the Midgard Serpent encircled the Earth and began crushing it, Thor fought and defeated the monster.
Drained the power of an amplified Galactus and unleashed it as a bomb to destroy the Black Winter.
Reclaimed Mjolnir, lifted the Destroyer skyward inside a whirlwind and turned its own energy beam back to wreck it.
Without his hammer, he called down a massive lightning bolt to blast Hela back, then cut through her Berserker army.

sources.label: Marvel Cinematic Universe Wiki: Thor: Ragnarok

feats.text: Held open Nidavellir's iris and took the full force of a star so Stormbreaker could be forged.
